 Summary
 Arsenal beat Everton to move level on points with Premier League leaders Man City
 Konsa & Gabriel give Gunners comfortable home win
 Fulham win 1-0 at Coventry through second-half Bobb strike
 Aston Villa end City's 100% start thanks to Jackson double - report & ratings 
 Chelsea v Tottenham follows at 17:30
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Gary Rose & Sam Drury
 Show Most recent Most popular 'Was this game ever really in doubt?' published at 17:02 BST 17:02 BST 
 FT: Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 For Arsenal, it was just above a cruise. Not a complete cruise because they had to work a bit for it but was this game ever really in doubt? I never thought so. 
 Arsenal are a top side, one of the best if not the best domestic sides around.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:00 BST 17:00 BST 
 FT: Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 An Arsenal win and one that seemed to come with a minimum of fuss.
 Mikel Arteta is still in animated discussion with the officials at the end, though. He wasn't happy with something.
 TV presenter Dermot O'Leary looks altogether more relaxed in the stands. Dare I say that his Saturday night starts right here?
 48 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Everything Everton have got is not good enough for Arsenal' published at 16:59 BST 16:59 BST 
 FT: Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Everton have given absolutely everything they've got which they do every week but everything they've got is not good enough for Arsenal. Arsenal are a long way ahead of them and I think Arsenal's second XI is possibly a long way ahead of them as well. 
 This is not where Everton get the points they need this season, there's going to be other places against the other teams around them so I don't think David Moyes will be too upset by the way the game has gone.
 58 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 16:56 BST 16:56 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Job done for Arsenal. A pretty routine home win but one that puts them level on points with leaders Manchester City.
 Ezri Konsa's first Gunners goal put the hosts ahead in the seventh minute before Gabriel, on his 200th Premier League appearance, headed in the second midway through the second half.
 Three points in the bag for the defending champions.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 647 79 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 16:56 BST 16:56 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 With the game petering out, there is just time for referee Tony Harrington to book another coach.
 This time it's Arsenal's Gabriel Heinze. I'm not quite sure what he did to upset the ref.
 86 233 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Arsenal are a well-drilled side' published at 16:54 BST 16:54 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 When Everton have won possession, the way Arsenal have got themselves structured and in to defensive positions has been exceptional. 
 Boy, they're a well-drilled side. 
 819 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:54 BST 16:54 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Martin Odegaard goes for goal again as the clock ticks down. Too much on it and it sails over the crossbar.
 188 80 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 FULL-TIME published at 16:54 BST 16:54 BST 
 Coventry 0-1 Fulham 
 All over and it is back-to-back Premier League wins for Fulham.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 369 84 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 16:53 BST 16:53 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 David Moyes needs to retire, game has passed him by, he has the players but won’t give the young ones a game. Very poor performance.
 Tony, Vancouver 
 347 728 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:52 BST 16:52 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Everton have offered precious little by way of threat or cutting edge in this match.
 Even when it seems things are opening up for them, a loose touch or wrong decision has seen it close up again.
 193 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 PENALTY APPEAL published at 16:51 BST 16:51 BST 
 Coventry 0-1 Fulham 
 Jack Rudoni gets past his marker down the right and into the box. He crosses and the ball strikes the arm of Shea Charles. Coventry fans want a penalty but nothing is given by the referee. VAR checks and it is clear Charles had his arm tucked in.
 183 91 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 George 'getting such little ball' published at 16:51 BST 16:51 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Again, little bits of excitement from that Everton left-hand side but it's been so few and far between. 
 Tyrique George looks lively but he's getting such little ball in that position. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 108 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:50 BST 16:50 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Arsenal are going to join Manchester City on 21 points at the top of the Premier League table, five points clear of Brighton - who play tomorrow - in third.
 303 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 INJURY TIME published at 16:49 BST 16:49 BST 
 Coventry 0-1 Fulham 
 We're into the first of five minutes added on.
 99 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It was always going to be difficult' published at 16:49 BST 16:49 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on Final Score 
 We always knew it was going to be a difficult game for Everton today in terms of the squad and where they're at. 
 You look at the strength in depth, Everton have been given opportunities but not many, another good performance from Arsenal 
 267 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 INJURY TIME published at 16:48 BST 16:48 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Eight added minutes to be played as Martin Odegaard thumps a shot high over the bar.
 119 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:47 BST 16:47 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Hayden Hackney makes sure David Raya is still paying attention with a shot from range. Easily saved and held by the Arsenal keeper.
 280 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:47 BST 16:47 BST 
 Coventry 0-1 Fulham 
 If Fulham can hold on they will leap out of the relegation zone and up to 12th - not bad after a difficult start for Álvaro Arbeloa.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 181 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:47 BST 16:47 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 Boos ring out as as a free-kick is given against Max Dowman as he tries to get past James Garner on the right wing.
 He did have hold of the Everton man's shirt but then Garner had a good grip of his as well.
 29 29 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:44 BST 16:44 BST 
 Arsenal 2-0 Everton 
 We've got a delay as Martin Zubimendi, who has not been on long, gets treatment for what looks like a pretty nasty nosebleed.
 As that goes on, Everton send on Charly Alcaraz for Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall.
